sources.label: Morphe patches for Pdb (pdb.app): premium unlock, ad removal, PairIP bypass and
sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Disables Glassdoor's PairIP integrity/licence verification (full VM + native check), restores the real Application class, removes the licence activity, and restores the runtime strings the VM would have provided.
No-ops AppsFlyer's start() and logEvent() entry points, so no install attribution or analytics events are sent.

Disables the AppsFlyer install-referrer receiver/provider and any Google measurement component, turns Crashlytics and Firebase/Google-Analytics collection off, and removes the install-referrer permission. FCM push is kept.
Points the launcher activity at the AppCompat @style/AppTheme instead of the splash theme, whose runtime theme-swap lives in the removed PairIP VM.
Removes the advertising-ID, ad-services and install-referrer permissions (and disables any ad-SDK init provider). Glassdoor ships no third-party ad SDK.
